# FILE: README.md

# Pauli Contextuality Lab

Machine-checked Lean 4.35.0 proofs, exact integer/rational verifiers, research preprints, and reproducible interactive labs unifying three Pauli contextuality research tracks: spectral bounds and Jonah's Conjecture E, exact disjoint Mermin configuration degrees, and finite-horizon sequential contextuality certificates.

[![CI](https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Lean 4.35.0 Verification](https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab/actions/workflows/lean-verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab/actions/workflows/lean-verify.yml)
[![Pages & Blueprint](https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab/actions/workflows/pages.yml/badge.svg)](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/)
[![License: Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0%20%2F%20CC--BY--4.0-green)](LICENSE)
[![Version 2.9.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.9.0-informational)](CHANGELOG.md)

![Pauli Contextuality Lab overview](docs/media/social-preview.svg)

**Status:** Active research preprints (`v2.9.0`, 25 November 2026) — **NOT externally peer reviewed**; AI-assisted under human direction ([LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md)).  
**Author:** Alexander S. Donahue, independent researcher ([ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648) · `0_0@0thernes.art`).  
**Live Portal & Blueprint:** [Pauli Contextuality Lab](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/) · [Lean 4 Dependency Blueprint](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/blueprint/) · [Papers](papers/README.md) · [Claims Ledger](CLAIMS.md) · [Statement Fidelity](docs/statement-fidelity.md) · [Errata & Withdrawal](ERRATA.md) · [Mega-Atlas Audit](docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md) · [Replication Protocol](REPLICATION.md)

> **Consolidation note:** This repository consolidates four earlier standalone Pauli repositories (`0thernes/hoggar-bound-lab`, `0thernes/hoggar-bound`, `0thernes/contextuality-tensor-lab`, and `0thernes/contextuality-evidence-lab`, all archived read-only with redirects) into one Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib `v4.35.0` workspace with a single deduplicated `third_party/` stack and open `Apache-2.0` / `CC-BY-4.0` licensing. The zero-Mathlib ray-pool Kochen–Specker repository remains separate at [`0thernes/kochen-specker-extremal-lab`](https://github.com/0thernes/kochen-specker-extremal-lab) to preserve its minimal Mathlib-free trust base.

## Five-Second Formal Proof Check (`#print axioms`)

Every theorem across all three Lean 4.35.0 libraries (`HoggarBound`, `ContextualityTensor`, `Evidence`) and the 12-target isolated `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` comparator bridge compiles with **zero `sorry`, zero `admit`, zero `native_decide`, and zero custom axioms**, verified across **6 independent Lean kernels** (`lean-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `lean-default`) via `lake comparator --paranoid` in CI. Exact verbatim output from `cd lean && lake env lean VerifyAll.lean` ([full 160-declaration + 2,206-theorem exhaustive log](results/lean-axioms-all.log), checked in CI by `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`):

```text
'HoggarBound.hoggar_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'HoggarBound.hoggar_bound_quaternionic' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'HoggarBound.mermin_peres' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

## Three Unified Research Tracks

| Track | Path & Lean Library | Headline Results | Preprint & Interactive Lab |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1 · Spectral Bounds & Conjecture E** | [`tracks/spectral-bounds/`](tracks/spectral-bounds/README.md) · `lean/HoggarBound/` | Universal & Kramers spectral floors; exact small degrees ($d(Q^+(3,2))=1$, $d(W(5,2))=63$, $d(Q^-(5,2))=9$); infinite pure-CCZ determinant family $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$ ($m \ge 1$, $N=6$ degree $2{,}016$); $N=4,5$ ladders & unconditional bounds ($1455$, $6444$); **Jonah's Conjecture E** across all 9 vertex cases for all $N \ge 4$; exact four-qubit C3 binary optima (**368 vs 344**, gap 24) via pure-integer MET-SDP certificates. | [Unified PDF](papers/spectral-bounds/unified-contextuality.pdf) · [C3 Lab](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/c3-lab/) · [Explorer](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/independent-review/) |
| **2 · Disjoint Mermin Configurations** | [`tracks/disjoint-mermin/`](tracks/disjoint-mermin/README.md) · `lean/ContextualityTensor/` | Exact closed-form contextuality degrees $d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2$ ($k$ disjoint Peres–Mermin squares) and $(6^k - 4^k)/2$ ($k$ Mermin pentagrams) with $2d_k/L_k \to 1$, directly answering **Section 6 of Muller & Saniga (`arXiv:2609.19862v1`)**. | [Paper PDF](papers/disjoint-mermin/contextuality-tensor.pdf) · [4-Qubit Lab](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/disjoint-mermin/) |
| **3 · Sequential Contextuality Evidence** | [`tracks/sequential-evidence/`](tracks/sequential-evidence/README.md) · `lean/Evidence/` | Sharp Peres–Mermin setting-bias bound $\min_c p(c)$, finite adaptive-tree supermartingale bound $\le z/T$, and constructive miscalibration counterexample (**97.24%** naive vs **0.89%** bias-aware false rejection at nominal 1%). | [Paper PDF](papers/sequential-evidence/whitepaper.pdf) · [Evidence Lab](https://0thernes.github.io/pauli-contextuality-lab/sequential-evidence/) |

## Quickstart

From a clean clone (Python 3.11–3.13, Node 22+, optional Lean 4 `elan` & GCC/Clang):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab.git
cd pauli-contextuality-lab
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1. Exact verification across all 3 tracks + dataset & third_party SHA-256 checksums
python scripts/verify_all.py

# 2. Automated Python (exact, Hypothesis property, mutation/fuzz, integrity) & Node suites
python -m pytest -v tests/
node --test tests/test_web_models.mjs

# 3. Audits, Blueprint declaration check & unified Pages build
python scripts/arithmetic_audit.py
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/build_blueprint.py
python scripts/build_site.py
```

Expected headline output: `ALL TRACK VERIFICATIONS PASSED.`, `50 passed` in pytest, `2 pass` in Node, and `PASS: Blueprint validated 27 nodes (162 Lean decls with exact GitHub #L links)`.

### Full Lean 4.35.0 Verification & 6-Kernel Comparator

```bash
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build HoggarBound ContextualityTensor Evidence Solution
lake env lean VerifyAll.lean
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

---

## Usage Examples

- **One-word task runner (`justfile` / `scripts/dev.sh`):**
  ```bash
  just test          # Run all Python + Node tests
  just verify-lean   # Build all 3 Lean libraries + VerifyAll + 6-kernel comparator
  just sanitizers    # Compile & run C11 engines under ASan/UBSan (Linux/macOS)
  just blueprint     # Check every \lean{...} declaration and rebuild dependency graph
  just reproduce     # Clean-clone full exact reproduction
  just audit         # Score repo against Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0 (90 items)
  ```
- **Failure / negative-control example:** Running Track 2 verification under Python `-O` deliberately fails rather than silently skipping `assert` checks (`python -O -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'tracks/disjoint-mermin/src'); import certificates"` exits non-zero with `RuntimeError`). Similarly, mutating any single entry in `data/c3_exact_optima_certs.json` or `tracks/sequential-evidence/results/stack_trials.json` is rejected by `tests/test_mutation_and_fuzz.py` and `tests/test_sequential_evidence.py`.

# FILE: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md

Canonical instructions for every coding agent working in `pauli-contextuality-lab` (Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Grok Build, Grok Bot, and others).
`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc`, and `llms.txt` only point here. Edit this file, never the pointers.
Full standard: `docs/build-standard.md` (Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0, 90 items).

## Project

- **Name:** Pauli Contextuality Lab (`pauli-contextuality-lab`)
- **Purpose:** Unified Lean 4.35.0 (Mathlib v4.35.0) and exact-arithmetic verification repository for three Pauli contextuality research tracks:
  1. `tracks/spectral-bounds/` (`lean/HoggarBound/`): Spectral floor (Hoggar/Kramers bound), floor-saturating states including the infinite pure-CCZ determinant family `|Psi_{3m}>`, classical N=4..5 ladders, exact four-qubit C3 binary optima (`368` vs `344`), and Jonah's Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases for every `N >= 4`.
  2. `tracks/disjoint-mermin/` (`lean/ContextualityTensor/`): Exact contextuality degrees `d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2` (`k` disjoint Peres-Mermin squares) and `(6^k - 4^k)/2` (`k` Mermin pentagrams), answering Section 6 of Muller & Saniga (`arXiv:2609.19862v1`).
  3. `tracks/sequential-evidence/` (`lean/Evidence/`): Exact finite-tree sequential contextuality evidence bounds and constructive setting-bias attack on the Peres-Mermin square (`97.24%` naive vs `0.89%` corrected false rejection at nominal `1%`).
- **Author:** Alexander S. Donahue (independent researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`)
- **Licenses:** `Apache-2.0` (`LICENSE`, all code) + `CC-BY-4.0` (`LICENSE-DOCS`, all papers/docs/figures) + MIT for vendored `third_party/` (`NOTICE`)
- **Manifest:** `repo.yaml` (schema: `repo-standard.schema.json`), `formalization.yaml` (Palomar-compatible Lean provenance)
- **Status:** Active research preprints — NOT externally peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction.

## Layout

- `lean/`: Single unified Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 package (`HoggarBound`, `ContextualityTensor`, `Evidence`, `Challenge`, `Solution`, `VerifyAll`, `comparator.json`).
- `tracks/`: Track-specific C11 engines, Python exact verifiers, interactive browser labs (`web/`), and checked JSON receipts (`results/`).
- `papers/`: Publication manuscripts (`spectral-bounds/`, `disjoint-mermin/`, `sequential-evidence/`), PDFs, LaTeX sources, BibTeX, and correspondence guide.
- `data/`: Witness hex masks, flat-state supports, and `data/MANIFEST.sha256`.
- `third_party/`: Single deduplicated vendored Tsotchke stack (`moonlab/`, `qgtl/`, `quantum_rng/`, `SHA256SUMS.json`).
- `blueprint/`: Lean Blueprint LaTeX (`blueprint/src/content.tex`) + declaration-checked dependency graph builder.
- `scripts/`: Unified verification (`verify_all.py`), Blueprint builder (`build_blueprint.py`), static site builder (`build_site.py`), citation/axiom/arithmetic audits, and Build Standard v1.2.0 auditors (`audit-repo.sh`, `Audit-Repo.ps1`).
- `tests/`: Automated Python (exact, Hypothesis property, negative, mutation/fuzz, integrity) and Node.js test suites.
- `docs/`: Architecture, ADRs, statement-fidelity table, threat model, operations, FAQ, glossary, run log, and 10-pass review logs.

## Commands

Run via `just <recipe>` or `bash scripts/dev.sh <recipe>`:

- `just setup`: Install pinned Python dependencies (`requirements.txt`) and fetch pinned Mathlib cache (`lean/`).
- `just build`: Build all three Lean libraries (`HoggarBound`, `ContextualityTensor`, `Evidence`) and compile C11 verifiers with `-Wall -Wextra`.
- `just test`: Run the unified Python (`pytest`) and Node (`node --test`) verification suites across all 3 tracks.
- `just lint`: Run `ruff`, `mypy`, C compiler warnings, and Batteries `lake exe runLinter` (report-only).
- `just sanitizers`: Compile and execute C11 engines under `-fsanitize=address,undefined`.
- `just verify-lean`: Build Lean modules, run exhaustive `#print axioms` audit (`VerifyAll.lean`), check zero forbidden tokens, and run 6-kernel `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`.
- `just blueprint`: Validate every `\lean{...}` declaration in `blueprint/src/content.tex` and build the dependency graph.
- `just site`: Assemble the unified GitHub Pages portal (`build/site/`) including all 3 browser labs, papers, and `/blueprint/`.
- `just reproduce`: Clean-clone end-to-end exact verification + audits + blueprint + site assembly.
- `just audit`: Score this repository against Build Standard v1.2.0 (`scripts/audit-repo.sh` / `scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1`).
- `just release X.Y.Z`: Bump `VERSION`, update `CHANGELOG.md`/`CITATION.cff`, tag `vX.Y.Z`, and push straight to `main`.

## Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0)

- **R1.** Nothing may gate, block, or slow a commit or push. No branch protection, no required status checks, no commit/tag signing requirements, no git hooks, no push protection, no merge queues, no coverage/lint/SAST/SBOM gates.
- **R2.** Commit and push straight to `main`. No pull requests and no feature branches.
- **R3.** CI is informational. Failures are findings fixed in follow-up commits to `main`.
- **R4.** Banned tools/files: no Dependabot/Renovate, no PR templates, no CodeRabbit, no Copilot review or `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, no `FUNDING.yml`.
- **R5.** One-person lean, not corporate. Prefer one file over a framework, one command over a checklist.
- **R6.** Never fabricate. Every number, claim, axiom output, badge, and test result must come from a real run of current code.
- **R7.** Classify every finding as exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot` (definitions in `docs/glossary.md`).
- **R8.** Precedence: Owner's explicit instruction > Hard Rules > Build Standard items > ecosystem conventions.

## Known Traps

- **`lean/Challenge.lean` intentional `sorry` stubs:** `Challenge.lean` contains `sorry` ONLY as the isolated statement-only specification checked against sorry-free `Solution.lean` by `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`. Never put `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, or custom `axiom` in any proof module or `Solution.lean`.
- **Single GitHub Pages site:** `.github/workflows/pages.yml` deploys `build/site/` assembled by `scripts/build_site.py`, mounting `/blueprint/` alongside all three interactive browser labs and papers. Never add a second Pages workflow.
- **PowerShell bracket safety on Windows:** On the author's ReFS Dev Drive (`Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\...`), always use `-LiteralPath` in PowerShell file cmdlets.
- **Honest affiliation & scope:** Always use `Alexander S. Donahue (independent researcher)` (never assert an unformed LLC). Never claim external peer review, journal acceptance, arXiv submission, or Palomar registration unless genuinely completed.

# FILE: CLAIMS.md

# Claims & Falsification Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every headline claim in `pauli-contextuality-lab` is tagged with its exact verification status (`kernel-checked`, `certificate-checked`, `paper proof`, `numerical_approximation`, or `open`) and an explicit falsification condition (Build Standard items B04 & B42).

| ID | Track | Claim | Evidence Tag | Verification Artifact | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Falsifier) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C01** | Track 1 | Universal spectral floor $(D-1)\beta_6(S,f) \le (D-2)|S|\sqrt{(D-1)|S|}$ for all $N \ge 1$ and $S \subseteq W(2N-1,2)$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/Bound.lean` (`hoggar_bound`), `Challenge.lean` Target 1 | Exhibiting any $N$-qubit Pauli set $S$ and $\pm 1$ assignment violating the inequality, or a non-standard axiom in `VerifyAll.lean`. |
| **C02** | Track 1 | Quaternionic / Kramers spectral floor ($n = D/2$) on $Q^-(2N-1,2)$ giving $d(Q^-(5,2))\ge 9$, $d(Q^-(7,2))\ge 291$, $d(Q^-(9,2))\ge 6501$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/Kramers.lean` (`hoggar_bound_quaternionic`), Target 2 | Any assignment on $Q^-(2N-1,2)$ beating the Kramers bound or violating antiunitary commutation. |
| **C03** | Track 1 | Exact small degrees: $d(Q^+(3,2))=1$, $d(W(5,2))=63$, $d(Q^-(5,2))=9$, and $2 \le d(W(3,2)) \le 3$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/TwoQubit.lean`, `Witness.lean` (`mermin_peres`, `degree_three_qubit`, `degree_three_qubit_elliptic`) | Any assignment violating $<63$ contexts in $W(5,2)$, $<9$ in $Q^-(5,2)$, or $0$ in $Q^+(3,2)$. |
| **C04** | Track 1 | Asymptotic half-violation limit $d/L \to 1/2$ for $W(2N-1,2)$, $Q^+(2N-1,2)$, $Q^-(2N-1,2)$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/AuditUpgrades.lean` (`*_fraction_tendsto_half`) | A sequence of assignments whose violated fraction stays bounded below $1/2 - \varepsilon$. |
| **C05** | Track 1 | Five-way saturation equivalence (`saturation_tfae`) and squareness $(2^N-1)|S| = \square$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/SaturationTheory.lean`, Target 3 | A floor-saturating set with $(2^N-1)|S|$ non-square or no flat pure state. |
| **C06** | Track 1 | Infinite non-closed contextual floor-saturating CCZ family $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$ ($m \ge 1$) + finite flat degrees $75, 480, 2016, 729344$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/NormPhaseFamily.lean`, `SaturatedPhaseSix.lean`, `Saturated*`, `norm_phase_family.py` (32/32 checks), Target 4 | A counterexample $m \ge 2$ where support is closed or degree differs from $\frac{1}{12}(q^3-1)q^3(q-1)(q-2)$. |
| **C07** | Track 1 | Jonah's Conjecture E holds in all 9 vertex cases for every $N \ge 4$ (canonical Hermitian eigenvalue-multiset separation) | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/ConjectureE.lean`, `AuditUpgrades.lean`, `conjecture_e_trace_formula.py` (136 checks), Target 6 | A case among the 9 where the constructed carrier pair is not cospectral or has identical completion spectra. *(Note: single-orbit transitivity of Jonah [J3, Thm B4] is a cited paper input, not in Lean.)* |
| **C08** | Track 1 | Exact four-qubit Case C3 global binary completion optima: $\min_y F(\sigma_0,y) = 368$ and $\min_y F(\sigma_1,y) = 344$ (exact gap 24) | `kernel-checked` | `lean/HoggarBound/C3ExactOptima.lean`, `c3_exact_optima_check.py` (10/10 checks), Target 5 | Any binary vector $y \in \{\pm 1\}^{64}$ giving $<368$ for $\sigma_0$ or $<344$ for $\sigma_1$. |
| **C09** | Track 1 | Unconditional Kramers-lifted bounds $d(W(7,2)) \ge 1455$, $d(Q^+(9,2)) \ge 6444$, CSS witnesses $(315, 1575, 6975)$, and master reduction to $d(Q^-(7,2)) \ge 315$ | `kernel-checked` (ladders/bounds) + `certificate-checked` (42-orbit census) | `lean/HoggarBound/ExactDegreesN4N5.lean`, `w52_census_verify.c`, `exact_degrees_n4_n5.py` (9/9), Targets 7–8 | An assignment violating $<1455$ lines in $W(7,2)$ or $<315$ in $Q^-(7,2)$, or an orbit missed by the 42-orbit C census. |
| **C10** | Track 1 | Exhaustive $N=9$ cyclic-invariant rank-8 search finds 0 hits across 540,299,769 forms | `certificate-checked` (C census, outside Lean) | `tracks/spectral-bounds/src/n9_rank8_search.c`, `tracks/spectral-bounds/results/n9_rank8_search.tsv` | Exhibiting a cyclic-invariant cubic form on 9 qubits with constant rank 8. |
| **C11** | Track 2 | Exact degrees $d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2$ ($k$ disjoint Peres-Mermin squares) and $(6^k - 4^k)/2$ ($k$ Mermin pentagrams) with $2d_k/L_k \to 1$ | `kernel-checked` | `lean/ContextualityTensor.lean`, `ActualModel.lean`, `tests/test_disjoint_mermin.py`, Targets 9–10 | Any deterministic assignment on $k$ disjoint blocks violating fewer than $(7^k - 5^k)/2$ (squares) or $(6^k - 4^k)/2$ (pentagrams) union contexts. |
| **C12** | Track 3 | Sharp Peres-Mermin setting-bias failure floor $\min_c p(c)$, finite adaptive-tree hitting bound $\le z/T$, and miscalibrated 1% test false-rejection probability $97.2443815\%$ vs $0.8907211\%$ at horizon 1,000 | `kernel-checked` (bounds & 36-step counterexample) + `certificate-checked` (exact rational 1,000-step DP & 18,000-trial replay) | `lean/Evidence/{Square,Sequential}.lean`, `tracks/sequential-evidence/scripts/verify_artifact.py`, `tests/test_sequential_evidence.py`, Targets 11–12 | A valid finite tree exceeding $z/T$ hitting probability, or a rational DP discrepancy against exhaustive path enumeration. |
| **C13** | All | Browser labs and Moonlab / QGTL / `quantum_rng` runs | `numerical_approximation` (classical simulation) | `third_party/`, `results/arithmetic-audit.json` | Not a hardware quantum claim; falsified if simulator disagrees with exact analytical Pauli expectations beyond stated tolerance. |

# FILE: LIMITATIONS.md

# Limitations, Epistemic Boundaries, and AI-Contribution Disclosure

## 1. Real vs. Metaphor & What Is Not Claimed

- **Not externally peer reviewed:** All three manuscripts in `papers/` are unreviewed research preprints. Passing Lean 4 kernel checks certifies the logical validity of the formalized statements inside Lean — not external referee acceptance, historical priority, or statement-to-literature fidelity.
- **No quantum hardware measurements:** Moonlab (`third_party/moonlab/`) is a classical state-vector simulator compiled to WebAssembly; `quantum_rng` (`third_party/quantum_rng/`) is a seeded classical pseudorandom generator; QGTL (`third_party/qgtl/`) provides classical differential-geometry C kernels. Nothing in this repository is a physical experiment on quantum hardware or certified quantum randomness.
- **Prior work & unreviewed preprint citations:**
  - The spectral floor inequality and Conjecture E stem from unreviewed Zenodo preprints by B. W. Jonah (`doi:10.5281/zenodo.23538829`, `23510634`, `23524332`).
  - Symplectic polar-space degrees and the repeated-disjoint-copy problem come from A. Muller, M. Saniga, F. Holweck, A. Giorgetti, and C. Kelleher (`arXiv:2407.02928`, `arXiv:2609.19862v1`).
  - $d(Q^+(7,2))=315$ is due to Li, Gupta, and Ganesh (`arXiv:2610.26465`); the numerical five-qubit flat state is due to Cieśliński (`arXiv:2610.07172`); the scalar skewness bound is Okumura (1974).
  - Novelty claims (Track 1 Section 5 flat states and $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$, Track 1 Conjecture E formalization, Track 2 arbitrary-$k$ closed forms) rest on bounded literature searches and do not claim exhaustive historical priority.

## 2. Explicit Kernel Boundary (What Lies Outside Lean 4)

The following items are **not** certified by the Lean 4 kernel and are explicitly tagged as `certificate-checked`, `paper proof`, or `numerical_approximation` in `CLAIMS.md`:

1. **42-orbit `W(5,2)` census (`tracks/spectral-bounds/src/w52_census_verify.c`):** Exhaustive C11 enumeration (17,652,160 classes across 42 orbits) + pure-integer Python duals reproducing Jonah's $(315, 1575, 6975)$. Lean proves the exact master reduction (`exact_degrees_n4_n5_of_q7minus_315`) and unconditional bounds `1455` and `6444`, not the C orbit search itself.
2. **Nine-qubit cyclic-symmetry rank-8 search (`n9_rank8_search.c`):** C11 enumeration of 540,299,769 forms (0 hits).
3. **Single-orbit transitivity input (`Jonah [J3, Theorem B4]`):** Cited paper input for transporting Conjecture E to arbitrary hyperplane classes outside our constructed representatives.
4. **Floating-point scripts:** Every Python file using `numpy` or floating-point arithmetic is automatically classified in `results/arithmetic-audit.json` (`scripts/arithmetic_audit.py`) and never relied upon for a formal proof.
5. **Physical assumptions of Track 3 (`Evidence`):** The finite adaptive-tree theorem assumes a true conditional setting floor $\beta$ and single context-independent value table per trial; no empirical transcript alone can certify those physical assumptions.
6. **Human line-by-line statement fidelity audit:** `formalization.yaml` explicitly records `human_line_by_line_review_recorded: false` until an independent mathematician (or the author line-by-line) signs off on every row of `docs/statement-fidelity.md`.

## 3. AI-Contribution & CRediT Statement

- **Author:** Alexander S. Donahue (independent researcher, ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648)). No legal entity or institutional affiliation is claimed.

  - **Anthropic Claude:** Initial spectral-floor and saturation studies, Conjecture E paper proofs, disjoint Mermin formulas, sequential evidence proofs and verifiers.

# FILE: ERRATA.md

# Errata, Versioning Policy, and Withdrawal Plan (`ERRATA.md`)

This ledger records substantive mathematical, formalization, bibliographic, and metadata corrections across all releases of `pauli-contextuality-lab` (Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3, Checklist #39 & H28).

## 1. Versioning and DOI Policy

- **Single version source:** The canonical version lives in `VERSION` (SemVer `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) and is synchronized across `CHANGELOG.md`, `CITATION.cff`, `formalization.yaml`, `lean/lakefile.toml`, `README.md`, and all manuscript headers via automated regression tests (`tests/test_repo_integrity.py`).
- **Preprint revision convention:** Each tagged GitHub release (`vX.Y.Z`) freezes a specific PDF, `lean-axioms-all.log`, `data-MANIFEST.sha256`, `SHA256SUMS`, and source archive. If deposited to Zenodo or HAL, **cite the version-specific DOI** when referencing exact proof line numbers, theorem counts, or artifact hashes, and the **concept/all-versions DOI** only when citing the ongoing repository generically.
- **No fabricated identifiers:** Currently `doi: null`, `arxiv_identifier: null`, and `journal_submission_identifier: null` in `papers/spectral-bounds/unified-metadata.json`. No external DOI or arXiv identifier will be asserted until an actual deposit completes.

## 3. Correction & Withdrawal Plan

If a mathematical error, statement-fidelity mismatch (definition drift or vacuity between a paper claim and its Lean formalization), soundness flaw in a verifier, or undisclosed prior art is discovered:

1. **Report intake:** Open a GitHub issue (tagged `error`, `bug`, or `hole`) or email `0_0@0thernes.art` with the exact commit/version, theorem/file path, and counterexample or discrepancy.
2. **Triage & reproduction (target: within 72 hours):** Reproduce the counterexample or discrepancy, classify it under the 10-class Build Standard v1.2.0 taxonomy, and record an explicit entry in this `ERRATA.md` table and in `CLAIMS.md` / `docs/statement-fidelity.md`.
3. **Correction release (non-fatal errors):** Publish a new SemVer release (`vX.Y.(Z+1)`) fixing the proof, code, and manuscripts, never force-pushing or rewriting tagged history so older citations remain verifiable.
4. **Formal withdrawal (fatal theorem failure):** If a headline theorem fails due to an unrepairable mathematical or definition-fidelity defect:
   - Immediately add a prominent `[WITHDRAWN]` banner at the top of `README.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, the affected manuscript PDF/HTML/TeX, and this `ERRATA.md` explaining the exact failure mechanism and crediting whoever found it.
   - Publish a superseding withdrawal version on GitHub Releases and any external preprint server where the paper has been deposited (e.g., arXiv withdrawal comment, Zenodo new version with withdrawal notice, HAL update, or `ai.viXra.org` replacement notice). Never silently delete prior versions.

# FILE: REPLICATION.md

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

This document gives the exact, clean-clone commands to reproduce every automated test, exact verifier, C11 sanitizer check, Lean 4.35.0 proof, 6-kernel comparator replay, Blueprint build, and GitHub Pages assembly.

## 1. Prerequisites

- **Git**
- **Python 3.11–3.13** (`pip install -r requirements.txt`)
- **Node.js 22+** (for browser-model unit tests and Moonlab WASM checks)
- **GCC or Clang** (C11, optional `-fsanitize=address,undefined` on Linux/macOS)
- **Lean 4 (`elan`)** — automatically selects `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` from `lean/lean-toolchain`
- **Bubblewrap (`bwrap`)** on Linux for sandboxed `lake comparator --paranoid`

## 2. Clean-Clone Replication Commands

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/pauli-contextuality-lab.git
cd pauli-contextuality-lab

# 1. Python & Node verification suites + exact verifiers + audits + Blueprint + site
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/verify_all.py
python -m pytest -v tests/
node --test tests/test_web_models.mjs
python scripts/arithmetic_audit.py
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/build_blueprint.py
python scripts/build_site.py

# 2. C11 engines with AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (Linux/macOS)
bash scripts/dev.sh sanitizers

# 3. Full Lean 4.35.0 build, exhaustive axiom audit & 6-kernel comparator
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build HoggarBound ContextualityTensor Evidence Solution
lake env lean VerifyAll.lean
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

## 3. Replication Log

External independent replications are welcomed — open an issue or email `0_0@0thernes.art` with your OS, tool versions, commit SHA, and command output to add a row below.

| Date | Replicator | Environment | Scope Verified | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-24 | Alexander S. Donahue (author / local & CI) | Windows 11 + Ubuntu 24.04 GitHub Actions, Python 3.12/3.13, Node 22, Lean 4.35.0 | Unified 3-track Lean build, `VerifyAll.lean`, `verify_all.py`, `pytest`, Node tests, Blueprint, site, Build Standard v1.1.0 audit | Pass (author-run; independent external replication still open) |
| 2026-11-25 | Alexander S. Donahue (author / local & CI) | Windows 11 + WSL2 + Ubuntu 24.04/macOS/Windows CI, Python 3.12, Node 22, Lean 4.35.0 | `v2.9.0` Build Standard v1.2.0 (`100.0%`, `68/68`), Playbook v1.3 checks (adversarial false-variant Lean tests, Crossref retraction audit, 14-engine C11 ASan/UBSan, 6-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid`) | Pass (author-run; independent external replication still open) |

# Cross-Reference Against the Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas V2 (`1,900` Problems)

**Audit date:** 2026-11-25  
**Source catalog:** [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) (`outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.json`, `1,900` curated open problems across 28 superdomains)  
**Scope audited:** All three tracks of `pauli-contextuality-lab` (`v2.9.0`) plus cross-check across all 12 registered papers (`0TH-2026-001`–`0TH-2026-012`) in [`0thernes/0thernes-research-archive`](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive).

## Executive Verdict (Strictly Honest, Zero Overclaiming)

- **Grand Mega-Atlas problems completely solved:** **`0 / 1,900`**.
  None of the 1,900 civilizational / grand-challenge open problems in the Mega-Atlas V2 is completely resolved by `pauli-contextuality-lab` or any paper in `0thernes-research-archive`.
- **Concrete finite-dimensional / domain subproblems genuinely settled inside Lean 4.35.0 (`pauli-contextuality-lab`):**
  Our verified theorems resolve **specific, bounded open conjectures in finite-dimensional Pauli contextuality** directly situated under Mega-Atlas entry **`QM-011`** (*Quantum Contextuality, Ontological Models & Psi-Ontic vs. Psi-Epistemic Realism*), while leaving the broader `QM-011` grand problem (Spekkens generalized contextuality across continuous variables and full resource characterization) **OPEN**:
  1. **Jonah's Conjecture E (all 9 hyperplane-carrier vertex cases for all $N \ge 4$):** Proved in Lean 4.35.0 (`HoggarBound.ConjectureE.jonah_conjecture_e_all_nine_cases`, `AuditUpgrades.jonah_conjecture_e_all_nine_cases_spectra`), plus exact four-qubit Case C3 global binary completion optima (`368` vs `344`, exact gap `24`, `C3ExactOptima.corollary16_exact_binary_optima`). *(Caveat: transport to arbitrary hyperplane classes relies on cited Theorem B4 of Jonah [J3] outside Lean.)*
  2. **Muller & Saniga (`arXiv:2609.19862v1`, Section 6) repeated disjoint Mermin copies:** Proved exact closed-form degrees $d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2$ for $k$ disjoint Peres–Mermin squares and $(6^k - 4^k)/2$ for $k$ disjoint Mermin pentagrams, with normalized degree $2d_k/L_k \to 1$, in Lean 4.35.0 (`ContextualityTensor.square_minimum_closed_form`, `pentagram_minimum_closed_form`, `global_actual_*`).
  3. **Infinite non-closed floor-saturating pure-CCZ determinant family $|\Psi_{3m}\rangle$ ($m \ge 1$):** Proved in Lean 4.35.0 (`HoggarBound.NormPhaseFamily.infinite_nonclosed_saturated_family`), alongside exact kernel-checked finite degrees `75`, `480`, `2016`, `729344`.
  4. **Sequential Peres–Mermin setting-bias floor & finite adaptive-tree supermartingale bound:** Proved in Lean 4.35.0 (`Evidence.sharp_minimum`, `BetTree.finite_hitting_bound`, `concrete_classical_false_positive`).

## Detailed Mapping of Closest Mega-Atlas V2 Entries

|---|---|---|---|---|
